uboot.shell_net_setup: ip link set eth0 up; ip addr add {client_ip}/24 dev eth0 2>/dev/null; echo CW-NET-$?

notes: busybox multi-call dispatch refuses stty on official 24.10.2 and 25.12.6 images (verified on-box 2026-10-25): serial binary transfers require a custom rescue image with the stty applet
canonical-mode console echoes binary as caret notation — echo storms hard-lock the CPU (printk/8250 class, SUSE KB 7025302 family)
ethernet for bytes, serial for steering; ACK-paced YMODEM survives, raw streams do not
